Permission screen: Authored app

Apps and hosts
- crm (read): crm.example.com; purpose not stated
- routine 'one' contacts api.example.com

Connectors
- crm: read; purpose not stated

Tools the run may use
- one: no tool list declared in app.toml
- A run may not use a send tool (push, email, Slack or any other) that this screen does not list.

Logic delivered by
- one: repo

Schedule
- one: UTC cron 0 6 * * *, 1 run a day
- Routine 'one': 1 run a day.
- Total: 1 run a day against your cap of 1 run a day.
- The shortest allowed schedule interval is 1 hour.
- The platform allows 100 scheduled runs per hour across the account and 30 per hour for one task.

Environment and secrets
- Environment: none
- Environment settings: not reported. RoutineOS cannot read network access, allowed domains, network secrets, setup script or environment variables; confirm them in the environment dialog on claude.ai.
- No secrets are declared in app.toml.

Store
- Kind: artifact-db
- Collection 'leads' written by one

Budget
- Ceiling: 1 run a day (prompt-enforced, not guaranteed).
- When the ceiling is passed, further runs are meant to stop and no alert channel is set, so nobody is told.

First run
- The first run is report-only: it reads and reports what it would do, and nothing is sent or written outside the store.

Not yet checked
- Reliance: no platform dependencies are declared in [risks].relies_on, so none are verified.
- Environment settings: not reported, so no host's reachability is checked.

Nothing is created until you say yes. A change to any line above makes a new screen.
